title: Point density contours
intent: Reveal the shape and overlap of Palmer Penguins bill measurements with a two-dimensional kernel density estimate.

ai.create: Create six filled density contours over Palmer Penguins bill measurements. Plot should use density; TanStack should map the original measurement fields with the supplied scales and inject d3-contour's contourDensity through a local custom mark.
ai.maintain: Preserve the pixel bandwidth, threshold count, scale domains, and responsive estimator size. Do not replace the battle-tested density estimator with custom kernel math.
